messages:
SRE-Bot: PAGER -> embeddings-service (eu-west-1) — 5xx spike detected, 10m avg error rate 12%. Paging current oncall. <@Maria Chen>
Maria Chen: On train, no voice for 90s but can remote. ETA ~2m. Can someone stand primary until I confirm?
Kevin Patel: I can pick up primary for the next 15m. Switching now to avoid customer impact.
Jamie O'Neill: I can be secondary. If you need to escalate to dedicated capacity or rollback a model, I can run the runbook.
Lina Park: Creating incident bridge and notifying Support team. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/6123456780 (added oncall rotation)
SRE-Bot: Bridge created by Lina Park. Notifying #support-customers.
Kevin Patel: Quick check — errors look like transient 5xx from model workers running out of mem. Logs show kernel OOM traces on worker-4.
Maria Chen: Copy. Runbook section: embeddings-service -> "hot-5xx-triage". Quick checklist: 1) reduce traffic to risky variant 2) scale up pool 3) enable fallback model.
Kevin Patel: Doing step 1: applying temporary traffic split to divert 30% to embeddings-stable-quant. Command:

```bash
redwood routes update --service embeddings-service --split 'stable=30,primary=70' --region eu-west-1
```

Kevin Patel: Done. Monitoring.
SRE-Bot: Metric update: 5xx dropped from 12% -> 6% within 60s, p95 latency unchanged.
Jamie O'Neill: If errors persist we should spin up another worker node and pin model to a lower-memory quant profile. Runbook snippet: fallback model name = "embeddings-stable-quant".
Maria Chen: On wifi now. Taking context. Kevin, if you can scale a node, I'll check model KV cache stats and flush if needed.
Kevin Patel: Spinning up one extra GPU node (scale +1) via autoscale policy 'embeddings-burst'. ETA ~45s.
SRE-Bot: Autoscale event: started node gpu-emb-07 in eu-west-1.
Lina Park: Support has opened a ticket with the affected customers and posted a short status: "We are investigating increased errors with embeddings in EU. Temporary mitigation in progress."
Kevin Patel: Node up. Rebalancing workers — traffic now 80/20 stable/primary as safety. 5xx now at 2.1% and still trending down.
Maria Chen: Flushed KV cache on primary shard to clear potential stale state: `curl -XPOST http://localhost:8180/kv/flush` — confirmed no regression.
Jamie O'Neill: Good. Leaving a note in the incident timeline: reason likely memory pressure on model worker; mitigation applied: traffic split + scale + cache flush. Recommend follow-up: set autoscale threshold lower for that model and add eviction metrics to alerting.
Lina Park: Logged follow-up action item: "autoscale threshold tuning" and assigned to Maria Chen.
Maria Chen: I'm back on primary. Thanks Kevin & Jamie for the temporary takeover. Dropping a short runbook improvement PR after postmortem. :thumbsup:
Kevin Patel: No problem. Marking incident as mitigated for now. I'll keep the temporary traffic split for 30m then revert if stable.
SRE-Bot: Incident status -> MITIGATED. 5xx steady < 2.5% for 10m.
Maria Chen: Closing handoff: I'm primary again. If anything flares, re-pager me. Appreciate the fast cover and bridge.
Jamie O'Neill: Excellent teamwork. Added a small note to runbook: "If oncall unreachable, swap primary in rotation and follow these commands."
Lina Park: Thanks all — I'll update customers and create the postmortem template.
Maria Chen: Thanks Lina. Off to file PR and postmortem. :raised_hands:
